neighboring_unit_entries.title: A signed bipartite graph turns residue exponent positivity into component squares
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: The first exponent inequality is encoded by a bipartite graph on positive and negative weights. Structural properties forbid sign-paired cycles and force a singleton component, so a sum of squared component weights is strictly positive and dominates the required exponent.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: After residues are divided into critical and remote scale classes, signed bipartite component structure supplies a positive exponent gap; nested graphs propagate that gap through every intermediate asymptotic scale.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: The certification depends on the prescribed limiting relations among the shifts and proves negligibility only in this residue comparison.
